finding: All 45 signs were audited; zero qualified for the frozen landmark representation and no substantive null draws followed.
limitations: Standardized drawings are not ancient impression measurements; the result does not refute shell/angle organization itself.

The original recipe requires Python with numpy/scipy/Pillow/matplotlib and Inkscape. It specifies how to extract the included reference ZIP and restore the expected source layout. No dependencies were installed or environment recreated here.

The full 167-member archive includes all standardized source SVGs, reference ZIP, per-sign data and diagnostic PNGs. The 2 MB self-contained illustrated report opens only on selection. Same-executor separate-code checks are not an independent human review.
This assembly inherits the recorded scientific checks and does not establish deployment behavior or public permission.

Preserved archive: Phaistos_Geometry_02_Execution_2026-10-06.zip. The attached files are inspection selections; they do not replace its complete runtime directory. No public archive URL or permission is implied. Full figures, historical versions and omitted dependencies remain in that archive.
S01–S45 identities and Pen/Pencil alternatives remain as recorded. Display orientation is not proven reading direction; no decoding or acceptance of Visual Families follows.
Public source selections omit specified private identifiers or provenance-sensitive inputs; private originals and source hashes remain preserved.
method: The preserved execution measures all 45 standardized drawings under the frozen representation checks. Its gate fails before inferential sampling; code, landmark records, diagnostics and saved checks are retained.
open_questions: Further generalization remains a separate research question; it is not a prerequisite for presenting the recorded bounded outcome.
